RSP Data Analytics Dashboard - Database Schema
================================================
Last updated: 2026-04-29
Engine: DuckDB (single file at data/dashboard.db at runtime)
Sources: server/schema.yaml (dim tables), server/storage/database.py (_init_schema)

================================================================================
SEQUENCES
================================================================================

seq_audit_log_id              START 1    (schema.yaml)
seq_meas_lttb_id              START 1    (schema.yaml)
seq_saved_filter_id           START 1    (schema.yaml)
seq_event_access_id           START 1    (schema.yaml)
seq_channel_map_id            START 1    (database.py)
seq_meas_raw_id               START 1    (database.py)
seq_custom_field_value_id     START 1    (database.py)
seq_event_custom_field_value_id START 1  (database.py)
seq_ingestion_artifact_id     START 1    (database.py)

================================================================================
TABLES
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
dim_program  (schema.yaml)
  Program metadata
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  program_id          VARCHAR       PK
  name                VARCHAR       NULLABLE
  created_at          TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
dim_event  (schema.yaml + database.py ALTER TABLE additions)
  Event metadata with filter columns. One row per uploaded CSV file.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- Identity
  event_id            VARCHAR       PK
  program_id          VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  version             VARCHAR       NOT NULL

  -- Filter columns (with UI filter config in schema.yaml)
  status              VARCHAR       filter order=1   values: Approved, Obsolete, Pending
  rfq                 BOOLEAN       filter order=2   values: Applicable, Not Applicable
  dv                  BOOLEAN       filter order=3   values: Applicable, Not Applicable
  pv                  BOOLEAN       filter order=4   values: Applicable, Not Applicable
  post_prod           BOOLEAN       filter order=5   values: Applicable, Not Applicable
  suspension_component VARCHAR      filter order=6   values: A-Arm (UCA), A-Arm (LCA), L-Arm, H-Arm, Trailing Arm, Tension Link, Lateral Link, Upper Trailing Link, Lower Trailing Link, Camber Link, Spring Link, Toe Link
  axle_location       VARCHAR       filter order=7   values: Front, Rear
  gross_vehicle_weight_range_lbs VARCHAR filter order=8 values: 1000-1500 .. 9500-10000 (18 ranges, 500lb increments)
  fgawr_range_lbs     VARCHAR       filter order=9   values: 1000-1500 .. 9500-10000
  rgawr_range_lbs     VARCHAR       filter order=10  values: 1000-1500 .. 9500-10000
  drive_type          VARCHAR       filter order=11  values: ICE, BEV, PHEV
  material_construction VARCHAR     filter order=12  values: Steel (stamped & welded), Steel (forged), Steel (stamped), Ductile Iron (cast), Aluminum (forged), Aluminum (cast)
  steering_position   VARCHAR       filter order=13  values: RHS, LHS
  damper_type         VARCHAR       filter order=14  values: Coil Over, Air Suspension
  vehicle_type        VARCHAR       filter order=15  values: Sedan, Truck, Van, SUV, Heavy Duty, Off-Road, Other

  -- Non-filter data columns
  gvw                 VARCHAR
  fgawr               VARCHAR
  rgawr               VARCHAR
  job_number          VARCHAR
  work_order          VARCHAR

  -- Ownership (multi-user)
  uploaded_by_user_id VARCHAR       NULLABLE (added via ALTER TABLE)
  last_updated_by_user_id VARCHAR   NULLABLE (added via ALTER TABLE)

  -- System
  source_file         VARCHAR
  file_hash           VARCHAR(16)
  row_count           INTEGER
  is_deleted          BOOLEAN       DEFAULT FALSE
  created_at          TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  updated_at          TIMESTAMP

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
dim_channel_map  (database.py)
  Plot channel configuration per program/version/plot_key
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  id                  BIGINT        PK  DEFAULT nextval('seq_channel_map_id')
  program_id          VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  version             VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  plot_key            VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  x_col               INTEGER       zero-based CSV column index
  y_col               INTEGER       zero-based CSV column index
  x_channel           VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  y_channel           VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  plot_order          INTEGER       DEFAULT 0
  x_scale_factor      DOUBLE        DEFAULT 1.0
  y_scale_factor      DOUBLE        DEFAULT 1.0
  x_unit              VARCHAR
  y_unit              VARCHAR
  UNIQUE (program_id, version, plot_key)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ingestion_artifacts  (database.py)
  Retained CSV artifacts for pending channel-map setup and later reprocessing
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  artifact_id         BIGINT        PK  DEFAULT nextval('seq_ingestion_artifact_id')
  program_id          VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  version             VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  source_file         VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  artifact_path       VARCHAR       NOT NULL  (relative to data_root)
  artifact_kind       VARCHAR       NOT NULL  (csv, converted_csv)
  file_hash           VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  row_count           INTEGER       DEFAULT 0
  column_count        INTEGER       DEFAULT 0
  preview_json        JSON          first 20 CSV lines for editor preview
  metadata_json       JSON          upload metadata needed for later processing
  custom_fields_json  JSON          upload custom-field values
  status              VARCHAR       DEFAULT 'pending' (pending, processed, failed)
  error               VARCHAR
  event_id            VARCHAR       processed dim_event id, when available
  owner_user_id       VARCHAR
  created_at          TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  updated_at          TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  UNIQUE (program_id, version, file_hash)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
users  (database.py)
  Authenticated users
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  id                  VARCHAR       PK
  username            VARCHAR       NOT NULL UNIQUE
  role                VARCHAR       NOT NULL   (values: user, admin)
  password_hash       VARCHAR
  can_write           BOOLEAN       DEFAULT FALSE  (admin rows forced TRUE; ALTER TABLE IF NOT EXISTS)
  created_at          TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  last_login_at       TIMESTAMP
  last_settings_visit_at TIMESTAMP                  (admin notification baseline; ALTER TABLE IF NOT EXISTS)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
measurements_raw  (database.py)
  Raw time-series signal data in long format
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  id                  BIGINT        PK  DEFAULT nextval('seq_meas_raw_id')
  event_id            VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  timestamp           DOUBLE        NOT NULL
  channel_name        VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  value               DOUBLE

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
measurements_lttb  (database.py)
  LTTB-downsampled plot data
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  id                  BIGINT        PK  DEFAULT nextval('seq_meas_lttb_id')
  event_id            VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  plot_key            VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  x                   FLOAT         NOT NULL
  y                   FLOAT         NOT NULL

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
sessions  (database.py)
  User session state (JSON blobs + expiry)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  session_id          VARCHAR       PK
  user_id             VARCHAR       (added via ALTER TABLE)
  data_state          JSON          (added via ALTER TABLE; replaces baseline/new_data)
  baseline_state      JSON          (legacy, kept for migration)
  new_data_state      JSON          (legacy, kept for migration)
  global_filters      JSON
  rendered_event_ids  JSON          (added via ALTER TABLE)
  ui_preferences      JSON
  created_at          TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  updated_at          TIMESTAMP
  expires_at          TIMESTAMP

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
upload_tasks  (database.py)
  Upload task state for async CSV progress streaming
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  task_id             VARCHAR       PK
  created_by_user_id  VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  status              VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  phase               VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  completed_events    INTEGER       DEFAULT 0
  total_events        INTEGER       DEFAULT 0
  current_event       VARCHAR
  error               VARCHAR
  result_json         JSON
  created_at          TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  updated_at          TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  expires_at          TIMESTAMP     NOT NULL

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
saved_filters  (database.py)
  Saved filter presets
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  id                  BIGINT        PK  DEFAULT nextval('seq_saved_filter_id')
  user_id             VARCHAR       (added via ALTER TABLE)
  name                VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  data_state          JSON          (added via ALTER TABLE; replaces baseline/new_data)
  baseline_state      JSON          (legacy, kept for migration)
  new_data_state      JSON          (legacy, kept for migration)
  global_filters      JSON
  is_default          BOOLEAN       DEFAULT FALSE
  created_at          TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
user_preferences  (database.py)
  Per-user UI preferences
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  user_id             VARCHAR       PK  DEFAULT 'default'
  pinned_baseline_event_id VARCHAR
  default_program_id  VARCHAR
  grid_columns        INTEGER       DEFAULT 3
  grid_layout_order   JSON
  theme               VARCHAR       DEFAULT 'light'
  baseline_opacity    FLOAT         DEFAULT 0.5
  created_at          TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  updated_at          TIMESTAMP

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
audit_log  (database.py)
  Audit trail for tracked actions
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  id                  BIGINT        PK  DEFAULT nextval('seq_audit_log_id')
  action              VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  user_id             VARCHAR
  event_id            VARCHAR
  details             JSON
  timestamp           TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
event_access_log  (database.py)
  Event access tracking
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  id                  BIGINT        PK  DEFAULT nextval('seq_event_access_id')
  event_id            VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  access_type         VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  partition           VARCHAR
  accessed_at         TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
custom_field_definitions  (database.py)
  Admin-defined custom filter fields
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  field_key           VARCHAR       PK
  display_name        VARCHAR       NOT NULL UNIQUE
  data_type           VARCHAR       NOT NULL DEFAULT 'string'
  is_filterable       BOOLEAN       DEFAULT TRUE
  created_by_user_id  VARCHAR
  created_at          TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  updated_at          TIMESTAMP

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
custom_field_allowed_values  (database.py)
  Program-scoped allowed values for custom fields
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  id                  BIGINT        PK  DEFAULT nextval('seq_custom_field_value_id')
  field_key           VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  program_id          VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  value               VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  sort_order          INTEGER       DEFAULT 0
  created_at          TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  UNIQUE (field_key, program_id, value)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
event_custom_field_values  (database.py)
  Event-level custom field values
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  id                  BIGINT        PK  DEFAULT nextval('seq_event_custom_field_value_id')
  event_id            VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  field_key           VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  value               VARCHAR       NOT NULL
  created_at          TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  UNIQUE (event_id, field_key)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
_schema_metadata  (database.py)
  Schema metadata for portability / runtime discovery
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  key                 VARCHAR       PK
  value               JSON
  updated_at          TIMESTAMP     DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

================================================================================
INDEXES
================================================================================

idx_event_program                      dim_event(program_id)
idx_event_version                      dim_event(program_id, version)
idx_event_status                       dim_event(status)
idx_event_deleted                      dim_event(is_deleted)
idx_event_file_hash                    dim_event(file_hash)
idx_event_uploaded_by_user             dim_event(uploaded_by_user_id)
idx_channel_map                        dim_channel_map(program_id, version)
idx_meas_raw_event                     measurements_raw(event_id)
idx_meas_raw_event_channel             measurements_raw(event_id, channel_name)
idx_meas_lttb_event                    measurements_lttb(event_id, plot_key)
idx_meas_lttb_covering                 measurements_lttb(plot_key, event_id, x, y)
idx_sessions_expires                   sessions(expires_at)
idx_sessions_user                      sessions(user_id)
idx_upload_tasks_user                  upload_tasks(created_by_user_id)
idx_upload_tasks_expires               upload_tasks(expires_at)
idx_saved_filters_user                 saved_filters(user_id)
idx_users_username                     users(username)
idx_event_access_recent                event_access_log(accessed_at DESC)
idx_custom_field_definitions_filterable custom_field_definitions(is_filterable)
idx_custom_field_allowed_values_lookup  custom_field_allowed_values(field_key, program_id, sort_order)
idx_event_custom_field_values_event     event_custom_field_values(event_id)
idx_event_custom_field_values_field     event_custom_field_values(field_key, value)

================================================================================
LOGICAL RELATIONSHIPS (no enforced FKs)
================================================================================

dim_program.program_id        <-- dim_event.program_id
dim_event.event_id            <-- measurements_raw.event_id
dim_event.event_id            <-- measurements_lttb.event_id
dim_event.event_id            <-- event_custom_field_values.event_id
dim_event.event_id            <-- event_access_log.event_id
dim_channel_map(program_id, version)  links plot definitions for events
users.id                      <-- sessions.user_id
users.id                      <-- upload_tasks.created_by_user_id
users.id                      <-- saved_filters.user_id
users.id                      <-- dim_event.uploaded_by_user_id
users.id                      <-- audit_log.user_id
users.id                      <-- custom_field_definitions.created_by_user_id
custom_field_definitions.field_key <-- custom_field_allowed_values.field_key
custom_field_definitions.field_key <-- event_custom_field_values.field_key

Consistency is enforced by application logic, not DB constraints.
Use UnifiedStore.get_relationship_orphan_counts() to validate FK readiness.

================================================================================
NOTES
================================================================================

- Several dim_event columns are added via ALTER TABLE IF NOT EXISTS in
  database.py _init_schema for backwards compatibility with older .db files.
- Legacy "maturity" column is backfilled into "status" during init if present.
- schema.yaml version field tracks schema version for portability checks.
- _schema_metadata stores filter_options, filter_columns, schema_version
  for export/import compatibility validation.

Portable export format (admin UI / API), not the live DB file:
- Admin export produces a ZIP (e.g. dashboard_export.zip) containing Parquet files
  (ZSTD compression), plus schema.sql and load.sql generated by UnifiedStore.export_to_parquet.
- Admin import accepts that ZIP only; UnifiedStore.import_from_parquet rebuilds dashboard.db
  from those artifacts, then runs _init_schema() to align with the current app schema.
